    materialized='incremental',
    alias='FactTaxiTrip',
    quoting={'identifier': true},

    incremental_strategy='append' if var('s03_fast_append', false) else 'delete+insert',

  TASK T02 (TTU) & S03 (STINH) - MÔ HÌNH FACT TRUNG TÂM dds."FactTaxiTrip" (SINGLE DDS)
  - Grain: 1 dòng / 1 giao dịch chuyến xe riêng lẻ kết thúc thành công
  - 11 Role-playing Foreign Keys với quy ước khóa mặc định Key = 0 (Zero Orphaned FKs)
  - 40 Cột chuẩn hóa 100% theo Data Contract v1.2 & DDL PostgreSQL 16
  - Hỗ trợ s03_fast_append=true khi chạy Bulk Load 36 tháng và delete+insert mặc định
#}

with flagged_trips as (
    select *
    from {{ ref('stg_trips_flagged') }} f
    {% if is_incremental() and not var('b01_use_mock', false) and not var('fact_full_reload', false) %}
        {% if var('source_file_name', none) is not none %}
            where f.source_file_name = '{{ var("source_file_name") }}'
        {% elif var('load_batch_id', none) is not none %}
            where f.load_batch_id = '{{ var("load_batch_id") }}'
        {% else %}
            where f.loaded_at_utc >= (select coalesce(max("LoadedAtUTC"), '1970-01-01'::timestamp) from {{ this }})
        {% endif %}
    {% endif %}
),

    select "DateKey", "FullDate" from {{ ref('DimDate') }}
),

dim_date_dropoff as (
    select "DateKey", "FullDate" from {{ ref('DimDate') }}
),

),

dim_time_dropoff as (

dim_zone_dropoff as (

),

dim_vendor as (

),

dim_passenger_group as (

dim_distance_band as (

)

    -- 1. Khóa chính bất biến (Primary Key)
    f.trip_id::char(32)                                                     as "TripKey",

    f.dropoff_datetime                                                     as "DropoffDateTime",

    f.trip_distance                                                        as "TripDistanceMiles",
    f.trip_duration_seconds                                                as "TripDurationSeconds",

left join dim_date_pickup pd

left join dim_date_dropoff dd
    on dd."FullDate" = f.dropoff_datetime::date
left join dim_time_pickup pt

    on pz."LocationID" = f.pu_location_id
left join dim_zone_dropoff dz
    on dz."LocationID" = f.do_location_id
left join dim_vendor v
    on v."VendorID" = f.vendor_id
left join dim_payment p
    on p."PaymentTypeCode" = f.payment_type
left join dim_rate r
    on r."RateCodeID" = f.rate_code_id
left join dim_passenger_group pg
    on f.passenger_count between pg."MinPassengerCount" and pg."MaxPassengerCount"
left join dim_distance_band b
    on b."DistanceBandKey" = case
        when f.trip_distance is null or f.trip_distance < 0 then 0
        when f.trip_distance = 0 then 1
        when f.trip_distance <= 2 then 2
        when f.trip_distance <= 5 then 3
        when f.trip_distance <= 100 then 4
        else 5
    end

{#
  B02 (nbinh) - staging.stg_trips_flagged: stg_yellow_trips + bộ cờ chất lượng (Data Contract v1.2 mục 2.2).
  - Preserve & Flag: giữ nguyên 100% dòng của stg_yellow_trips, chỉ thêm cờ (không lọc, không nhân dòng).
  - 3 cờ usable + has_dq_issue luôn TRUE/FALSE, không NULL.
  - data_quality_flags: mã lỗi usable (thời gian, cự ly, tiền); attribute_quality_flags: cảnh báo thuộc tính.
  - Mapping vendor/rate code lấy từ seed dùng chung với DimVendor/DimRateCode (S02); KHÔNG đọc bảng dimension
    để tránh vòng phụ thuộc.
  Đầu vào của T02 (FactTaxiTrip).
#}
with stg as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_yellow_trips') }}
),

coded as (
    select
        stg.*,
        {{ dq_time_codes('stg') }}     as time_codes,
        {{ dq_distance_codes('stg') }} as distance_codes,
        {{ dq_amount_codes('stg') }}   as amount_codes,
        {{ dq_attribute_codes(
            'stg',
            'exists (select 1 from ' ~ ref('seed_vendor_mapping') ~ ' vm where vm.vendor_id = stg.vendor_id and ' ~ mapping_is_active('vm') ~ ')',
            'exists (select 1 from ' ~ ref('seed_rate_code_mapping') ~ ' rm where rm.rate_code_id = stg.rate_code_id and ' ~ mapping_is_active('rm') ~ ')'
        ) }}                           as attribute_codes
    from stg
)

select
    trip_id,
    vendor_id,
    pickup_datetime,
    dropoff_datetime,
    passenger_count,
    trip_distance,
    rate_code_id,
    store_and_fwd_flag,
    pu_location_id,
    do_location_id,
    payment_type,
    fare_amount,
    extra,
    mta_tax,
    tip_amount,
    tolls_amount,
    improvement_surcharge,
    congestion_surcharge,
    airport_fee,
    total_amount,
    trip_duration_seconds,
    store_and_fwd_flag_raw,
    money_rounded_columns,

    -- Bộ cờ chất lượng
    cardinality(time_codes) = 0                                             as is_time_usable,
    cardinality(distance_codes) = 0                                         as is_distance_usable,
    cardinality(amount_codes) = 0                                           as is_amount_usable,
    not (cardinality(time_codes) = 0
         and cardinality(distance_codes) = 0
         and cardinality(amount_codes) = 0)                                 as has_dq_issue,
    {{ dq_join_codes('time_codes || distance_codes || amount_codes') }}    as data_quality_flags,
    {{ dq_join_codes('attribute_codes') }}                                 as attribute_quality_flags,
    '{{ var("dq_rule_version") }}'::varchar(32)                             as quality_rule_version,

    -- Lineage
    source_file_name,
    source_file_sha256,
    source_row_number,
    load_batch_id,
    loaded_at_utc
from coded

with stg as (
    select * from "DW_DB"."staging"."stg_yellow_trips"
),

coded as (
    select
        stg.*,
        array_remove(array[
        -- Thiếu một trong hai mốc thời gian
        case when stg.pickup_datetime is null or stg.dropoff_datetime is null
             then 'MISSING_TIME' end,
        -- Ngày đón hoặc trả nằm ngoài miền (bao gồm hai biên)
        case when (stg.pickup_datetime is not null
                   and stg.pickup_datetime::date not between date '2020-12-31'
                                                               and date '2024-01-01')
               or (stg.dropoff_datetime is not null
                   and stg.dropoff_datetime::date not between date '2020-12-31'
                                                                and date '2024-01-01')
             then 'DATE_OUT_OF_DOMAIN' end,
        -- Trả khách không sau đón khách (bao gồm bằng nhau)
        case when stg.dropoff_datetime <= stg.pickup_datetime
             then 'TIME_REVERSED' end,
        -- Thời lượng vượt 24 giờ
        case when stg.trip_duration_seconds > 86400
             then 'DURATION_OVER_24H' end
    ]::text[], null)     as time_codes,
        array_remove(array[
        case when stg.trip_distance is null then 'MISSING_DISTANCE'
             when stg.trip_distance < 0     then 'NEGATIVE_DISTANCE'
             when stg.trip_distance = 0     then 'ZERO_DISTANCE'
             when stg.trip_distance > 100   then 'DISTANCE_OUTLIER'
        end
    ]::text[], null) as distance_codes,
        array_remove(array[
        -- Điều kiện 1: đủ dữ liệu và không âm
        case when stg.total_amount is null then 'MISSING_TOTAL_AMOUNT' end,
        case when stg.fare_amount  is null then 'MISSING_FARE_AMOUNT'  end,
        case when stg.tip_amount   is null then 'MISSING_TIP_AMOUNT'   end,
        case when stg.total_amount < 0  then 'NEGATIVE_TOTAL_AMOUNT'
             when stg.total_amount = 0  then 'ZERO_TOTAL_AMOUNT' end,
        case when stg.fare_amount  < 0  then 'NEGATIVE_FARE' end,
        case when stg.tip_amount   < 0  then 'NEGATIVE_TIP'  end,
        -- Điều kiện 2: chặn cực trị
        case when stg.total_amount > 5000 then 'AMOUNT_OVER_5000' end,
        -- Điều kiện 3: cấu thành cước hợp lý (sai số 1 cent; tolls thiếu tính là 0 chỉ trong phép kiểm)
        case when stg.total_amount + 0.01
                  < stg.fare_amount + stg.tip_amount + coalesce(stg.tolls_amount, 0)
             then 'INCONSISTENT_TOTAL' end
    ]::text[], null)   as amount_codes,
        array_remove(array[
        case when stg.passenger_count is null then 'MISSING_PASSENGER_COUNT'

{#
  B01 (nbinh) - Ép kiểu an toàn TOÀN BỘ dòng raw + ghi nhận lỗi chuyển kiểu theo từng cột.
  Hạ nguồn:
    stg_yellow_trips          = các dòng không có lỗi chuyển kiểu (đầu vào cho B02 stg_trips_flagged)
    stg_yellow_trips_rejects  = các dòng lỗi -> macro load_quarantine() ghi vào staging.quarantine
  Đối soát: COUNT(raw) = COUNT(stg_yellow_trips) + COUNT(stg_yellow_trips_rejects)
#}
{% set int_cols = [
    ('vendor_id', 'vendor_id'), ('passenger_count', 'passenger_count'),
    ('rate_code_id', 'rate_code_id'), ('pu_location_id', 'pu_location_id'),
    ('do_location_id', 'do_location_id'), ('payment_type', 'payment_type')
] %}
{% set money_cols = [
    'fare_amount', 'extra', 'mta_tax', 'tip_amount', 'tolls_amount',
    'improvement_surcharge', 'congestion_surcharge', 'airport_fee', 'total_amount'
] %}

with src as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_yellow_trips_source') }}
),

typed as (
    select
        -- Khóa giao dịch: MD5(sha256 || '_' || số dòng) - hex chữ thường, CHAR(32)
        md5(src.source_file_sha256::text || '_' || src.source_row_number::text)::char(32) as trip_id,

        {{ safe_int('src.vendor_id') }}                        as vendor_id,
        {{ safe_timestamp('src.tpep_pickup_datetime') }}       as pickup_datetime,
        {{ safe_timestamp('src.tpep_dropoff_datetime') }}      as dropoff_datetime,
        {{ safe_int('src.passenger_count') }}                  as passenger_count,
        {{ safe_numeric('src.trip_distance', 18, 6) }}         as trip_distance,
        {{ safe_int('src.rate_code_id') }}                     as rate_code_id,
        -- Chuẩn hóa 'Y'/'N' (không phân biệt hoa thường, bỏ khoảng trắng); giá trị khác -> NULL
        case upper({{ clean_text('src.store_and_fwd_flag') }})
            when 'Y' then 'Y' when 'N' then 'N'
        end::varchar(1)                                        as store_and_fwd_flag,
        {{ safe_int('src.pu_location_id') }}                   as pu_location_id,
        {{ safe_int('src.do_location_id') }}                   as do_location_id,
        {{ safe_int('src.payment_type') }}                     as payment_type,
        {% for c in money_cols %}
        {{ safe_numeric('src.' ~ c, 18, 2) }}                  as {{ c }},
        {% endfor %}

        -- Giá trị gốc giữ lại để B02 gắn INVALID_STORE_AND_FWD_FLAG / MONEY_ROUNDED / review độ chính xác cự ly
        {{ clean_text('src.store_and_fwd_flag') }}               as store_and_fwd_flag_raw,
        {{ clean_text('src.trip_distance') }}                    as trip_distance_raw,

        -- Giá trị tiền gốc (đã làm sạch) để phát hiện làm tròn ở bước sau, không xuất ra stg_yellow_trips
        {% for c in money_cols %}
        {{ clean_text('src.' ~ c) }} as raw_{{ c }},
        {% endfor %}

        -- Lineage
        src.source_file_name::varchar(255)                     as source_file_name,
        src.source_file_sha256::char(64)                       as source_file_sha256,
        src.source_row_number::bigint                          as source_row_number,
        src.load_batch_id::varchar(64)                         as load_batch_id,
        src.loaded_at_utc::timestamp                           as loaded_at_utc,

        -- Mã lỗi chuyển kiểu theo cột: mảng 'MA_LOI:ten_cot', bỏ phần tử NULL
        array_remove(array[
            {{ int_error('src.vendor_id') }} || ':vendor_id',
            {{ timestamp_error('src.tpep_pickup_datetime') }} || ':tpep_pickup_datetime',
            {{ timestamp_error('src.tpep_dropoff_datetime') }} || ':tpep_dropoff_datetime',
            {{ int_error('src.passenger_count') }} || ':passenger_count',
            {{ numeric_error('src.trip_distance', 18, 6) }} || ':trip_distance',
            {{ int_error('src.rate_code_id') }} || ':rate_code_id',
            {{ int_error('src.pu_location_id') }} || ':pu_location_id',
            {{ int_error('src.do_location_id') }} || ':do_location_id',
            {{ int_error('src.payment_type') }} || ':payment_type',
            {% for c in money_cols %}
            {{ numeric_error('src.' ~ c, 18, 2) }} || ':{{ c }}'{{ "," if not loop.last }}
            {% endfor %}
        ], null)                                               as cast_errors
    from src
)

select
    typed.*,
    -- Thời lượng chuyến (giây, giữ phần lẻ). Phép trừ timestamp: không có phép chia -> không thể lỗi chia cho 0.
    -- NULL khi thiếu một trong hai mốc; có thể âm (TIME_REVERSED do B02 gắn cờ, không xóa dòng).
    extract(epoch from (typed.dropoff_datetime - typed.pickup_datetime))::numeric(20,6) as trip_duration_seconds,
    cardinality(typed.cast_errors) > 0                                                  as has_cast_error,
    -- Tiền bị làm tròn khi chuẩn hóa về cent (Contract 2.2: giữ raw, B02 gắn MONEY_ROUNDED):
    -- các cột tiền có giá trị gốc khác giá trị sau làm tròn, sắp alphabet, nối ';'; không có thì NULL.
    -- Nhánh nhanh: chuỗi gốc có tối đa 2 chữ số thập phân thì chắc chắn không bị làm tròn.
    nullif(concat_ws(';'
        {% for c in money_cols | sort %}
        , case when typed.{{ c }} is null then null
               when typed.raw_{{ c }} ~ '^[+-]?[0-9]*(\.[0-9]{0,2})?$' then null
               when typed.raw_{{ c }}::numeric <> typed.{{ c }} then '{{ c }}'
          end
        {% endfor %}
    ), '')                                                                              as money_rounded_columns
from typed

macro.yellow_taxi_dwh.dq_time_codes.macro_sql:
{% macro dq_time_codes(t) -%}
    array_remove(array[
        -- Thiếu một trong hai mốc thời gian
        case when {{ t }}.pickup_datetime is null or {{ t }}.dropoff_datetime is null
             then 'MISSING_TIME' end,
        -- Ngày đón hoặc trả nằm ngoài miền (bao gồm hai biên)
        case when ({{ t }}.pickup_datetime is not null
                   and {{ t }}.pickup_datetime::date not between date '{{ var("dq_date_domain_start") }}'
                                                               and date '{{ var("dq_date_domain_end") }}')
               or ({{ t }}.dropoff_datetime is not null
                   and {{ t }}.dropoff_datetime::date not between date '{{ var("dq_date_domain_start") }}'
                                                                and date '{{ var("dq_date_domain_end") }}')
             then 'DATE_OUT_OF_DOMAIN' end,
        -- Trả khách không sau đón khách (bao gồm bằng nhau)
        case when {{ t }}.dropoff_datetime <= {{ t }}.pickup_datetime
             then 'TIME_REVERSED' end,
        -- Thời lượng vượt 24 giờ
        case when {{ t }}.trip_duration_seconds > 86400
             then 'DURATION_OVER_24H' end
    ]::text[], null)
{%- endmacro %}

macro.yellow_taxi_dwh.dq_amount_codes.macro_sql:
{% macro dq_amount_codes(t) -%}
    array_remove(array[
        -- Điều kiện 1: đủ dữ liệu và không âm
        case when {{ t }}.total_amount is null then 'MISSING_TOTAL_AMOUNT' end,
        case when {{ t }}.fare_amount  is null then 'MISSING_FARE_AMOUNT'  end,
        case when {{ t }}.tip_amount   is null then 'MISSING_TIP_AMOUNT'   end,
        case when {{ t }}.total_amount < 0  then 'NEGATIVE_TOTAL_AMOUNT'
             when {{ t }}.total_amount = 0  then 'ZERO_TOTAL_AMOUNT' end,
        case when {{ t }}.fare_amount  < 0  then 'NEGATIVE_FARE' end,
        case when {{ t }}.tip_amount   < 0  then 'NEGATIVE_TIP'  end,
        -- Điều kiện 2: chặn cực trị
        case when {{ t }}.total_amount > 5000 then 'AMOUNT_OVER_5000' end,
        -- Điều kiện 3: cấu thành cước hợp lý (sai số 1 cent; tolls thiếu tính là 0 chỉ trong phép kiểm)
        case when {{ t }}.total_amount + 0.01
                  < {{ t }}.fare_amount + {{ t }}.tip_amount + coalesce({{ t }}.tolls_amount, 0)
             then 'INCONSISTENT_TOTAL' end
    ]::text[], null)
{%- endmacro %}

    CASE

        WHEN ST_SRID({{ geom_col }}) = {{ target_srid }} THEN ST_Multi(ST_MakeValid({{ geom_col }}))::geometry(MultiPolygon, {{ target_srid }})
        WHEN ST_SRID({{ geom_col }}) = 0 THEN ST_Multi(ST_MakeValid(ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID({{ geom_col }}, {{ source_srid }}), {{ target_srid }})))::geometry(MultiPolygon, {{ target_srid }})
        ELSE ST_Multi(ST_MakeValid(ST_Transform({{ geom_col }}, {{ target_srid }})))::geometry(MultiPolygon, {{ target_srid }})
    END
{% endmacro %}

      -- in pg_depend, objid is the dependent, refobjid is the referenced object
      --  > a pg_depend entry indicates that the referenced object cannot be
      --  > dropped without also dropping the dependent object.
  #}

  {%- call statement('relations', fetch_result=True) -%}
    with relation as (
        select
            pg_rewrite.ev_class as class,
            pg_rewrite.oid as id
        from pg_rewrite
    ),
    class as (
        select
            oid as id,
            relname as name,
            relnamespace as schema,
            relkind as kind
        from pg_class
    ),
    dependency as (
        select distinct
            pg_depend.objid as id,
            pg_depend.refobjid as ref
        from pg_depend
    ),
    schema as (
        select
            pg_namespace.oid as id,
            pg_namespace.nspname as name
        from pg_namespace
        where nspname != 'information_schema' and nspname not like 'pg\_%'
    ),
    referenced as (
        select
            relation.id AS id,
            referenced_class.name ,
            referenced_class.schema ,
            referenced_class.kind
        from relation
        join class as referenced_class on relation.class=referenced_class.id
        where referenced_class.kind in ('r', 'v', 'm')
    ),
    relationships as (
        select
            referenced.name as referenced_name,
            referenced.schema as referenced_schema_id,
            dependent_class.name as dependent_name,
            dependent_class.schema as dependent_schema_id,
            referenced.kind as kind
        from referenced
        join dependency on referenced.id=dependency.id
        join class as dependent_class on dependency.ref=dependent_class.id
        where
            (referenced.name != dependent_class.name or
             referenced.schema != dependent_class.schema)
    )

    select
        referenced_schema.name as referenced_schema,
        relationships.referenced_name as referenced_name,
        dependent_schema.name as dependent_schema,
        relationships.dependent_name as dependent_name
    from relationships
    join schema as dependent_schema on relationships.dependent_schema_id=dependent_schema.id
    join schema as referenced_schema on relationships.referenced_schema_id=referenced_schema.id
    group by referenced_schema, referenced_name, dependent_schema, dependent_name
    order by referenced_schema, referenced_name, dependent_schema, dependent_name;

  {%- endcall -%}

  {{ return(load_result('relations').table) }}
{% endmacro %}

{# Acceptance-only projection of the T02 interface. Does NOT load FactTaxiTrip. #}
{{ config(enabled=var('integration_acceptance', false), materialized='table', schema='qa') }}
select f.trip_id::char(32) as "TripKey",
 coalesce(pd."DateKey", 0)::int as "PickupDateKey",
 coalesce(dd."DateKey", 0)::int as "DropoffDateKey",
 coalesce(pt."TimeKey", 0)::int as "PickupTimeKey",
 coalesce(dt."TimeKey", 0)::int as "DropoffTimeKey",
 coalesce(pz."ZoneKey", 0)::int as "PickupZoneKey",
 coalesce(dz."ZoneKey", 0)::int as "DropoffZoneKey",
 coalesce(v."VendorKey", 0)::int as "VendorKey",
 coalesce(p."PaymentTypeKey", 0)::int as "PaymentTypeKey",
 coalesce(r."RateCodeKey", 0)::int as "RateCodeKey",
 coalesce(pg."PassengerGroupKey", 0)::int as "PassengerGroupKey",
 coalesce(b."DistanceBandKey", 0)::int as "DistanceBandKey",
 f.pickup_datetime as "PickupDateTime",
 f.dropoff_datetime as "DropoffDateTime",
 f.store_and_fwd_flag as "StoreAndFwdFlag",
 1::int as "TripCount",
 f.passenger_count as "PassengerCount",
 f.trip_distance as "TripDistanceMiles",
 f.trip_duration_seconds as "TripDurationSeconds",
 f.fare_amount as "FareAmount",
 f.extra as "Extra",
 f.mta_tax as "MtaTax",
 f.tip_amount as "TipAmount",
 f.tolls_amount as "TollsAmount",
 f.improvement_surcharge as "ImprovementSurcharge",
 f.congestion_surcharge as "CongestionSurcharge",
 f.airport_fee as "AirportFee",
 f.total_amount as "TotalAmount",
 f.is_time_usable as "IsTimeUsable",
 f.is_distance_usable as "IsDistanceUsable",
 f.is_amount_usable as "IsAmountUsable",
 f.has_dq_issue as "HasDQIssue",
 f.data_quality_flags as "DataQualityFlags",
 f.attribute_quality_flags as "AttributeQualityFlags",
 f.quality_rule_version as "QualityRuleVersion",
 f.source_file_name as "SourceFileName",
 f.source_file_sha256 as "SourceFileSHA256",
 f.source_row_number as "SourceRowNumber",
 f.load_batch_id as "LoadBatchID",
 f.loaded_at_utc as "LoadedAtUTC"
from {{ ref('stg_trips_flagged') }} f
left join {{ ref('DimDate') }} pd on pd."FullDate" = f.pickup_datetime::date
left join {{ ref('DimDate') }} dd on dd."FullDate" = f.dropoff_datetime::date
left join {{ ref('DimTime') }} pt on pt."TimeKey" = extract(hour from f.pickup_datetime)::int * 60 + extract(minute from f.pickup_datetime)::int + 1
left join {{ ref('DimTime') }} dt on dt."TimeKey" = extract(hour from f.dropoff_datetime)::int * 60 + extract(minute from f.dropoff_datetime)::int + 1
left join {{ ref('DimZone') }} pz on pz."LocationID" = f.pu_location_id
left join {{ ref('DimZone') }} dz on dz."LocationID" = f.do_location_id
left join {{ ref('DimVendor') }} v on v."VendorID" = f.vendor_id
left join {{ ref('DimPaymentType') }} p on p."PaymentTypeCode" = f.payment_type
left join {{ ref('DimRateCode') }} r on r."RateCodeID" = f.rate_code_id
left join {{ ref('DimPassengerGroup') }} pg on f.passenger_count between pg."MinPassengerCount" and pg."MaxPassengerCount"
left join {{ ref('DimDistanceBand') }} b on b."DistanceBandKey" = case when f.trip_distance is null or f.trip_distance < 0 then 0 when f.trip_distance = 0 then 1 when f.trip_distance <= 2 then 2 when f.trip_distance <= 5 then 3 when f.trip_distance <= 100 then 4 else 5 end

-- B02: So khớp bộ cờ trên dữ liệu giả lập với kỳ vọng tính tay theo Contract v1.2 mục 2.2 / mục 4.
--   mock_expected_flagged       : 18 dòng contract (file mock_yellow_trips.csv)
--   mock_expected_flagged_edge  : ca biên ép kiểu + ca biên DQ
-- Trả về dòng nào thiếu/thừa hoặc lệch một trong 6 cột cờ.
with expected as (
    select 'mock_yellow_trips.csv'::varchar(255) as source_file_name, source_row_number,
           is_time_usable, is_distance_usable, is_amount_usable, has_dq_issue,
           data_quality_flags, attribute_quality_flags
    from {{ ref('mock_expected_flagged') }}
    union all
    select source_file_name, source_row_number,
           is_time_usable, is_distance_usable, is_amount_usable, has_dq_issue,
           data_quality_flags, attribute_quality_flags
    from {{ ref('mock_expected_flagged_edge') }}
),
actual as (
    select source_file_name, source_row_number,
           is_time_usable, is_distance_usable, is_amount_usable, has_dq_issue,
           data_quality_flags, attribute_quality_flags
    from {{ ref('stg_trips_flagged') }}
)
select coalesce(e.source_file_name, a.source_file_name)   as source_file_name,
       coalesce(e.source_row_number, a.source_row_number) as source_row_number,
       e.is_time_usable as exp_time, a.is_time_usable as act_time,
       e.is_distance_usable as exp_dist, a.is_distance_usable as act_dist,
       e.is_amount_usable as exp_amount, a.is_amount_usable as act_amount,
       e.has_dq_issue as exp_issue, a.has_dq_issue as act_issue,
       e.data_quality_flags as exp_dq, a.data_quality_flags as act_dq,
       e.attribute_quality_flags as exp_attr, a.attribute_quality_flags as act_attr
from expected e
full outer join actual a
  on a.source_file_name = e.source_file_name and a.source_row_number = e.source_row_number
where e.source_row_number is null
   or a.source_row_number is null
   or e.is_time_usable          is distinct from a.is_time_usable
   or e.is_distance_usable      is distinct from a.is_distance_usable
   or e.is_amount_usable        is distinct from a.is_amount_usable
   or e.has_dq_issue            is distinct from a.has_dq_issue
   or e.data_quality_flags      is distinct from a.data_quality_flags
   or e.attribute_quality_flags is distinct from a.attribute_quality_flags
